title: Four strokes, one at a time

blocks.text: Mechanics remember the four strokes as **suck, squeeze, bang, blow**. Tap **Start** below and step through them one at a time.

blocks.caption: One stroke per tap. Watch which valve is open each time.
blocks.narration: Tap Start, then Next, to move through the strokes one by one.

blocks.text: The piston slides **down** and the intake valve is **open**. The falling piston leaves low pressure behind it, so air and fuel get pushed in by the air outside. Same as pulling back the plunger on a syringe.
Both valves **close**. The piston comes back **up** and squeezes the mix into about a tenth of the space. Squeezed mix burns hotter and pushes much harder, which is the whole point.

Just before the piston reaches the top, the spark plug fires. The mix burns in a flash, the gas gets very hot, its pressure shoots up, and it shoves the piston **down** hard. This is the **only** stroke that makes power. The other three are just setting it up.
The exhaust valve **opens** and the piston comes **up** again, pushing the burnt gas out to the exhaust pipe. Then intake starts again, over and over.

blocks.title: Count the turns
blocks.text: Each stroke is half a crank turn. Four strokes = **2 full turns** of the crankshaft for every 1 power stroke.

lines: At 3,000 RPM: 3,000 ÷ 2 = 1,500 power strokes a minute
blocks.say: Four strokes times half a turn each is two turns. At three thousand R P M, that's fifteen hundred power strokes a minute, or twenty five bangs every second, in each cylinder.

blocks.title: So who pushes on the other three strokes?
blocks.text: A heavy wheel called the **flywheel** keeps spinning between bangs, like a merry-go-round you shoved once. Its momentum carries the piston through intake, compression and exhaust.

blocks.question: Which stroke actually makes the power?
blocks.explain: Only the power stroke pushes the piston. The other three use up a little energy, which the flywheel supplies.

blocks.question: During compression, the valves are…
blocks.explain: Both valves are shut so the mix has nowhere to go but get squeezed.

blocks.question: How many crankshaft turns does one full 4-stroke cycle take?
blocks.explain: Four strokes, each half a turn: 2 turns.
